title: Psychic medium explains the voice in the witch encounter as a guardian angel

tellings.quote: "Oh, that was your that was your guardian angel or your higher self or whatever you want to call it talking to you."

plain: A voice that a Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman heard during a frightening encounter with what he calls a witch, in a Los Angeles bungalow, was explained to him by a psychic medium friend as "your guardian angel or your higher self or whatever you want to call it talking to you." Friedman, who lived the encounter, tells Michels what the unnamed friend said in 2025. It would mean, on her reading, that something protective was watching over him that night.
